nodes.label: Boundary Metadata as Annotation
nodes.rationale: Cross-boundary RST relations can encode real narrative and discourse phenomena, so boundaries annotate a document-scale tree rather than partitioning parser input.

nodes.label: Automatic Accelerator Selection
nodes.rationale: The auto default removes the Apple Silicon foot-gun where the former CPU default silently ignored MPS.

nodes.label: InputTooLargeError Fallback
nodes.rationale: Explicit refusal is the recommended fallback because it is cheap, visible, honest, and preserves the one-tree architecture for accepted inputs.

nodes.label: Pre-Order Relation Ordering
nodes.rationale: Pre-order is recommended because it is predictable and places the root first in natural reading order.

nodes.label: Shared Numeric ID Space
nodes.rationale: A shared relation and EDU id space lets child identifiers resolve uniformly against one union.

nodes.label: Parse per Boundary
nodes.rationale: Rejected because multiple small parses flatten and lose hierarchical RST structure, cost N parser calls, and discard meaningful cross-boundary relations.

nodes.label: Slides Transcripts OCR and Mixed Documents
Phase 0 RST Quality Gate
nodes.rationale: Empirical inspection gates the architecture because structurally valid but semantically useless trees would not serve consumers.

nodes.label: Separate Content-Layer Knobs
nodes.rationale: Notes and furniture serve different rhetorical purposes, so one combined boolean would conflate meaningful speaker notes with boilerplate headers and footers.

nodes.label: Table Text Exclusion
nodes.rationale: Flattened table cells are excluded because treating a grid as prose produces poor RST input while table self-references remain available as boundaries.

nodes.label: Always Traverse Pictures
nodes.rationale: Picture traversal is structural support required for OCR PDFs; caption inclusion is controlled separately downstream.

nodes.label: Focused Upstream Pull Requests
nodes.rationale: Only maintainer-requested bug fixes should be extracted into focused branches; fork-specific architecture, tooling, and CI remain local.

nodes.label: Code and Formula Default Off
nodes.rationale: Formula content is bare LaTeX and code is usually source text rather than prose, so both remain excluded by default from RST harvest.

nodes.label: Self-Parsed DocLang XML
nodes.rationale: The doclang package validates documents but exposes no parser, DOM, or object model, so the integration parses XML itself.

nodes.label: Canonical Tree Reading Order
nodes.rationale: The body-rooted tree walk is canonical because storage order in texts does not represent document reading order.

nodes.label: Position-Tracking Harvester
nodes.rationale: export_to_text does not retain per-item character positions, so harvesting must track positions while using the canonical walker.

nodes.label: Sample-Scope Evidence Boundary
nodes.rationale: Claims are restricted to five inspected files or individual format fixtures and must not be generalized to all Docling documents.

nodes.label: Production Quality Across All Modules
nodes.rationale: Research provenance does not lower the quality bar for code now owned and maintained as production Python.

nodes.label: No Assumptions Rule
nodes.rationale: Every factual claim must carry direct evidence or remain visibly marked as an assumption pending verification.

nodes.label: Read-Only Analysis Constraint
nodes.author: github-spec-kit
nodes.rationale: Analysis reports inconsistencies without changing artifacts; remediation requires separate explicit approval.

nodes.label: Unit Tests for English
nodes.author: github-spec-kit
nodes.rationale: Custom checklists assess whether requirements are complete, clear, consistent, measurable, and scenario-complete rather than testing implementation behavior.

nodes.label: Sequential Targeted Questions
nodes.author: github-spec-kit
nodes.rationale: At most five questions are asked one at a time so each answer can resolve a high-impact ambiguity without overwhelming the user.

nodes.label: Constitution Scope Guard
nodes.author: github-spec-kit
nodes.rationale: Constitution work updates governance only; feature implementation intents are deferred to the appropriate follow-up workflow.
